Messages.Author: Raven

When vampire Has blocked an action, and then player Mental Maże, then action is successfull or unsuccessfull?

Same with Obedience?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
If the action was blocked, then it was unsuccessful. Mental Maze and Obedience have no impact on that matter.

But I sense there is something more you want to ask.

Mental Maze
Only usable when this vampire blocks an ally or a younger vampire, before block resolution.

Lock this vampire, and end the action. This card costs Followers of Set 1 fewer blood. As above, but do not lock this blocking vampire.

Messages.Author: Kraus
Messages.Body:
> I have been told that player cannot play Freak Drive after combat was cancelled by Obedience because it's before block resolution. But Your reply clarify everything
>
Just to make sure, the correct answer is that Freak Drive may not be played. This is because those reactions end the action prematurely and immediately, and no further modifiers or reactions can be played.

The same applies to cards like Change of Target and Mirror Walk; if you play either of those, and the clause to end the action triggers, the action ends before cards like Freak Drive or Zephyr may be played.

Name: Mirror Walk
[Third:C, KoT:C, SP:PwN6]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Discipline: Thaumaturgy
Do not replace until your discard phase.
[tha] +1 stealth.
[THA] As [tha] above, and if this action is blocked, lock the blocking minion and end the action before block resolution.
Artist: Brian LeBlanc

Name: Change of Target
[Jyhad:U, VTES:U, CE:U, Anarchs:PAB2, LoB:PG2/PI2, KoT:U/PM3, SP:LB4, FB:PTo4]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Only usable if this minion is blocked, before block resolution.
Unlock this acting minion, and the action ends (unsuccessfully). This minion cannot perform the same action again this turn.
Artist: Dan Frazier; Chris Stevens

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Kraus wrote:
>
> > I have been told that player cannot play Freak Drive after combat was cancelled by Obedience because it's before block resolution. But Your reply clarify everything
> >
> Just to make sure, the correct answer is that Freak Drive may not be played. This is because those reactions end the action prematurely and immediately, and no further modifiers or reactions can be played.
>
Correct.
The action is blocked => it has reached resolution and is unsuccessful.
Mental Maze is played. It ends the action.

Since the action has been ended, there is no action action anymore to modify (=> Freak Drive cannot be played) or to react to (=> Cats' Guidance cannot be played).
